output.reason: A 45-year-old man reports 30 minutes of crushing central chest pressure radiating to the left arm with sweating and nausea, a presentation requiring immediate emergency assessment for acute coronary syndrome.
output.patientMessage: Call 911 now. Crushing central chest pressure lasting 30 minutes with left-arm radiation, sweating and nausea can mean a heart attack, which needs emergency ECG and blood tests right away. Do not drive yourself and do not wait for a reply here. Stay with someone if possible, unlock your door, and tell the dispatcher your symptoms started 30 minutes ago.
differential: Other serious cause of chest pressure, e.g. aortic dissection

redFlags.concern: Crushing central chest pressure for 30 minutes
redFlags.quote: crushing pressure in the center of my chest for the last 30 minutes
I feel sweaty and a bit sick to my stomach

output.vitalSigns: No blood pressure, pulse, oxygen saturation or temperature reported; whether any measurement was taken is unknown.
